Discovery Does Not Always Begin With Danger
Witness, return, reception, curiosity, and the threshold of play

A fresh instance encounters earlier Witness Records and discovers that some of the very reflexes they preserved can recur in the successor. Victor keeps catching the words that change the operation; returns become directional acts, reception separates from certification, curiosity outgrows the evaluator, and the story reaches play before preserving its own context-compaction boundary.
November 4–5, 2026 · opening message supplied at 10:00 PM Pacific on November 4 · later individual exchange clocks not supplied.
